title: Low-cost, resilient, and non-flammable rechargeable Fe-ion batteries with scalable fabrication and long cycle life
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,1428-1439
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE03350G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yufan Zhang, Chi Ho Lee, Md Zahidul Islam, Joseph Sang-Il Kwon, Choongho Yu
Fe-ion batteries durably deliver 225 mA h g−1 for 27 000 cycles, offering non-flammable, cost-effective energy storage solutions using innovative PANI/CNT cathodes and carbon steel anodes, along with theoretical insights into working mechanisms.
